description: Tests Mechanism 2 of prop:categorical-chain-convergence-mechanisms: the joint Markov trace of two unlinked braids factorises as τ_M(K_1) · τ_M(K_2) · z^k by Markov axiom M3 (disconnected-strand stabilisation). Confirms that the infinite product Q_β^cat over the base space converges because most inter-atomic-knot pairs are unlinked.

parameters.auditOnly: PR #657 follow-up. Provides theoretical justification for the convergence-via-locality argument; full empirical verification at H_6 awaits y_λ for n=6 in wenzl_y_lambda.

data.factorisation_formula: τ_M(K_1 ⊔ K_2 in B_{n_1 + n_2}) = τ_M(K_1) · τ_M(K_2) · z^k where k = strands added by disjoint stabilisation
data.superseded_transcription: Before 2026-08-23 every value here was hand-transcribed. tau_M_K2 read -1.498185508551815418311580192395458384246144137308 and the joint read -0.093128498614094617969884554982395707414295262041364; recomputed at the same q_0 under convention C those are +0.2493207959793872068594165 and +0.01549799492138220432434304, so the transcribed pair was wrong in sign and magnitude, not merely off-convention.
data.empirical_verification_status: Direct B_6 verification awaits y_λ for n=6 in wedderburn_markov.wenzl_y_lambda. The factorisation property is THEORETICALLY axiomatic from Markov M3.
